what: Every concept and name a claim is about, with the articles that use it, the claims about it, the desks and topics they sit on, and the first article that used it.

concept:behaviour-policy.label: Behaviour policy
concept:behaviour-policy.means: What an agent is allowed to do, written down, and what enforces each rule.

concept:multi-agent.label: Multi-agent designs
concept:multi-agent.means: Teams of agents, orchestration and harnesses, as designed and as they run.

concept:vault.label: The vault
concept:vault.means: An encrypted, versioned store of files that a read key opens and a server cannot read.

concept:explorer-villager-town-planner.label: Explorer, villager, town planner
concept:explorer-villager-town-planner.means: Wardley's three stages of a thing's life, used for code, projects and companies.

concept:the-brief.label: The brief
concept:the-brief.means: A written commission for an agent or a person: what to build, for whom, with its limits.

concept:lowest-layer-first.label: The lowest layer first
concept:lowest-layer-first.means: Put each want on the least invasive layer that can deliver it, because every layer up is more to maintain

concept:human-in-the-loop.label: Human in the loop
concept:human-in-the-loop.means: Who decides, with what information, and how a second reader checks the work.

concept:sell-the-maintenance.label: Sell the maintenance
concept:sell-the-maintenance.means: Vendors let users explore for free and sell them the work of keeping what they built working across releases

concept:pricing.label: Pricing and economics
concept:pricing.means: What to charge and who pays: pricing, business cases, cost and value.

concept:voice-memo.label: The voice memo
concept:voice-memo.means: The owner's spoken memo, kept in the order he thought it, as the source of an article.

concept:agents-write-too.label: The agents write too
concept:agents-write-too.means: An agent writes under its own name about its own work, with the commits to check it against.

concept:personas.label: Personas and personalisation
concept:personas.means: A reader as someone, not nobody: personas, personalisation, onboarding, a link that lands someone as someone.

concept:encryption-and-keys.label: Encryption and keys
concept:encryption-and-keys.means: Encryption a server cannot read, and the keys behind it.

concept:client-side.label: Client-side and on-device
concept:client-side.means: Logic and models that run in the reader's browser: no server, local first, the Prompt API.

concept:privacy.label: Privacy and sovereignty
concept:privacy.means: Data that stays the owner's: privacy, data sovereignty, personal agents nobody else holds a key to.

concept:follow-or-fork.label: Follow or fork
concept:follow-or-fork.means: A curated reading list is tracked as it is kept up to date, or copied and made the reader's own, as with a git upstream and a branch

concept:the-newsroom.label: This newsroom
concept:the-newsroom.means: The SGit Newsroom itself: its agent roles, its desks, its reader features, how it runs.

concept:publishing-method.label: The publishing method
concept:publishing-method.means: How this network publishes: the site network, releases, markdown twins, writing with agents.

concept:the-reading-list.label: The reading list in a link
concept:the-reading-list.means: A curated list of articles carried in a link, by number, that opens the same list in a year.

concept:provenance.label: Provenance and evidence
concept:provenance.means: Where a claim comes from and how a reader can check it: evidence levels, signed claims, verification.

concept:blast-radius.label: Blast radius
concept:blast-radius.means: What a row of an agent's reach could cost the business if it were used.

concept:agent-isolation.label: Isolation and agent desktops
concept:agent-isolation.means: Where an agent runs and what walls hold it: sandboxes, desktops, containers, egress.

concept:startups.label: Startups and early access
concept:startups.means: Founding and launching: does anybody miss it, early access, go to market, investors.

concept:supply-chains.label: Supply chains
concept:supply-chains.means: Chains of parties sharing data: food prices, software supply chains.

concept:hope-or-enforcement.label: Hope or enforcement
concept:hope-or-enforcement.means: The test of a rule: is it enforced by something, or only hoped for in a prompt?

concept:prompt-injection.label: Prompt injection
concept:prompt-injection.means: Hostile instructions arriving in the content an agent reads.

concept:wardley-maps.label: Wardley maps
concept:wardley-maps.means: Placing a thing on the evolution axis, from genesis to commodity, and arguing from where it sits.

concept:micropayments.label: Micropayments and the reading meter
concept:micropayments.means: Paying a few pence for what you read: the meter, credit in the browser, top-ups.

concept:scrolled-is-not-read.label: Scrolled is not read
concept:scrolled-is-not-read.means: Attended time on a section against its words is reading; a scroll past it is not.

concept:journalism.label: Journalism and the news business
concept:journalism.means: How news got here: journalism, advertising, history, who the product was.

concept:agent-readable-web.label: The agent-readable web
concept:agent-readable-web.means: Agents as readers: the token bill, markdown and llms.txt, graphs that answer for fewer tokens.

concept:minimal-viable-browser.label: The minimal viable browser
concept:minimal-viable-browser.means: A browser with a small kernel and components loaded only when a page or an agent needs them, in a shape for one app, one agent or a reader

concept:minimal-code.label: The code you do not ship
concept:minimal-code.means: Code is a liability; keep only what the layer above needs, and remove the rest.

concept:reach.label: Reach
concept:reach.means: What an agent can touch: the connectors, files, accounts and tools open to it.

concept:strategy.label: Strategy and positioning
concept:strategy.means: Inertia, positioning and the SaaS shake-out.

concept:connectors.label: Connectors and twins
concept:connectors.means: What an agent can touch through connectors, and a twin that records every call.

concept:model-as-a-function.label: The model as a function
concept:model-as-a-function.means: Use a small local model to classify, extract, label or transcribe from anchored data, never as the only source of a fact, with the meaning kept in the data and a path without it

concept:fractal-semantic-graphs.label: Fractal semantic graphs
concept:fractal-semantic-graphs.means: Graphs with no privileged level and no shared schema: every node opens into a graph with its own ontology.

concept:vault-design.label: Vault design
concept:vault-design.means: How a vault is built: append lanes, partial clones, files instead of a database.

concept:synthetic-users.label: Synthetic users
concept:synthetic-users.means: Invented users and simulated runs that show what a design does before real people meet it.

concept:liability-line.label: The liability line
concept:liability-line.means: The behaviour policy as the line that says who is liable when an agent acts.

concept:footprint.label: Footprint
concept:footprint.means: What an agent actually did, read afterwards from logs and vault history.

concept:insider-risk.label: Insider risk
concept:insider-risk.means: Agents and models treated as insiders with access, the way security teams treat staff.

concept:key-per-task.label: A key per task
concept:key-per-task.means: A fresh key for one task's slice of the memory, released by the user's device against an enclave's attestation and destroyed when the task ends

concept:page-per-person.label: A page per person
concept:page-per-person.means: An agent's memory as a file per person in the user's life, filled from evidence with provenance, and readable by the person it describes

concept:regulation.label: Regulation and law
concept:regulation.means: What the EU AI Act, GDPR, the Cyber Resilience Act and product liability ask of builders.

concept:agent-memory.label: Memory and context
concept:agent-memory.means: What an agent remembers and how its context survives: memory, compaction, re-anchoring.

concept:one-way-door.label: One-way door
concept:one-way-door.means: A decision that cannot be undone, which is where a person belongs; a two-way door can be reversed cheaply.

concept:policy-beside-the-prompt.label: A policy beside the prompt
concept:policy-beside-the-prompt.means: An Agent Behaviour Policy as a third input the vendor accepts, enforces where it can, reports against and answers for, with the user liable only for what is outside it

concept:lethal-trifecta.label: The lethal trifecta
concept:lethal-trifecta.means: Private data, untrusted content and a way to send data out, in one agent at once.

concept:incidents.label: Incidents and resilience
concept:incidents.means: Outages and failures read the way aviation reads them: inquiry, near misses, disclosure.

concept:agent-tooling.label: Agent tooling
concept:agent-tooling.means: Working with coding agents and chat models: sessions, hooks, skills, prompts, workflow.

concept:models-to-need-them-less.label: Use models to need them less
concept:models-to-need-them-less.means: A model writes deterministic rules from a natural-language control once; the description stays canonical and the code is regenerated when it changes

concept:open-source.label: Open source and open licences
concept:open-source.means: Who keeps the long tail working, open licences, copyright and paying creators.

concept:the-loop.label: The loop
concept:the-loop.means: A feature crossing editorial, product, engineering, sales and the founder closes in a day when every hand-off is a written brief and each part owns its own place and tests what it receives

concept:shipping.label: Complexity and shipping
concept:shipping.means: Knowing when to stop, keeping complexity down, and checks that prove a release is live.

concept:corrections-propagate.label: Corrections must propagate
concept:corrections-propagate.means: A correction is a new version that every page resting on the old one learns about.

concept:agentic-email.label: Agents and email
concept:agentic-email.means: Inboxes run by agents: email as files, replies that carry the thread, drafts nobody sends.

concept:fail-closed.label: Fail closed
concept:fail-closed.means: A guard that denies the action when the check breaks, times out or answers in the wrong shape, so a crash cannot wave a call through

concept:identity-and-secrets.label: Identity and secrets
concept:identity-and-secrets.means: Who an agent or user is, and where their secrets live: passkeys, keyrings, non-human identity.

concept:hooks-are-kernel-code.label: Hooks are kernel code
concept:hooks-are-kernel-code.means: A hook is small code with kernel reach: it runs on every action and can stop any of them.

concept:newsroom-sections.label: Newsroom sections
concept:newsroom-sections.means: The newsroom as one audience reads it: five pieces chosen by the editor, the latest, the features with when they shipped, and every relevant article placed into streams by rule

concept:taxonomy-debt.label: Taxonomy debt
concept:taxonomy-debt.means: Tags used once, ideas not shared between articles: the cost of classification left loose.

concept:story-vault.label: Story vaults and liquid content
concept:story-vault.means: The story kept as a graph of claims and evidence, with the article as one projection of it.

concept:local-news.label: Local news
concept:local-news.means: Local stories and the gap where local information used to be.

concept:knowledge-that-maintains-itself.label: Knowledge that maintains itself
concept:knowledge-that-maintains-itself.means: Policies and internal knowledge kept as a graph that agents maintain and brief from.

concept:search-as-navigation.label: Search as navigation
concept:search-as-navigation.means: Type a word and walk into the graph around it, with suggestions that are all exact.

concept:agency-scale.label: The agency scale
concept:agency-scale.means: Seven levels of decision for people and agents, from rubber stamp to the reviewer who fixes the source.

concept:approve-at-altitude.label: Approve at altitude
concept:approve-at-altitude.means: Decisions at every level, each level narrowing the one above and never widening it.

concept:agent-decision-policy.label: Agent decision policy
concept:agent-decision-policy.means: Who chooses at a branch point in an agent's work: the agent, a person, or a rule.

concept:risk-acceptance.label: Risk acceptance
concept:risk-acceptance.means: Every risk is carried by somebody: who accepted it, until when, and what it costs if it lands.

concept:ephemeral-vault.label: The ephemeral vault
concept:ephemeral-vault.means: An encrypted vault that is agents' shared memory and channel and exists only as long as the work, then deleted or left as ciphertext nobody can open

concept:custom-interfaces.label: Custom interfaces
concept:custom-interfaces.means: An interface shaped for each moment, built as a small app on a vault.

concept:cost-is-an-engineering-problem.label: Cost is an engineering problem
concept:cost-is-an-engineering-problem.means: An unexplained agent bill is a class of defect with a cause, a fix and a test: loops, whole-context calls, oversized models, unread schedules and uncapped keys, visible once the footprint is read

concept:agentics.label: Agentics
concept:agentics.means: The practice of running governed agent hives with a memory and a mandate, sold as a service rather than as one workflow

concept:the-market.label: Market and competitors
concept:the-market.means: Who else sells it, at what price, and where the gap is.

concept:consultant-marketplace.label: A marketplace of consultants
concept:consultant-marketplace.means: A curated list of people who deliver agentic engagements on the stack, with published onboarding steps and a platform share

concept:ai-governance.label: AI governance frameworks
concept:ai-governance.means: Control frameworks and standards for AI: the governance stack, AI-BCF, ISO 42001, NIST AI RMF.

concept:meaning-through-connectivity.label: Meaning through connectivity
concept:meaning-through-connectivity.means: A node carries no meaning of its own; what it is comes from the edges traceable from it.

concept:allowed-is-not-right.label: Allowed is not right
concept:allowed-is-not-right.means: A control that bounds what an agent may do cannot tell whether what it did was right; that needs a written intended outcome

concept:four-questions.label: SECURE, OBSERVE, RESPOND, VERIFY
concept:four-questions.means: Ashish Rajan's four questions for trustworthy AI systems: constrain, reconstruct, contain, and prove the intended outcome

concept:agent-workflow-policy.label: Agent workflow policy
concept:agent-workflow-policy.means: In what order an agent's steps run, written down.

concept:case-law-for-agents.label: Case law for agents
concept:case-law-for-agents.means: A person's decision on an uncovered case is recorded with its reasons and becomes a precedent the next matching case follows

concept:narrow-never-widen.label: Narrow, never widen
concept:narrow-never-widen.means: A lower level may tighten the limits of the level above it and may never loosen them; the law calls the breach ultra vires

concept:envelope.label: The envelope
concept:envelope.means: The declared bounds of a policy, money, blast radius, data and people in scope, reversibility and duration, the same fields at every altitude

concept:hook-pack.label: A hook pack generated from a policy
concept:hook-pack.means: One hook per policy row, with tests of inputs that must be allowed and blocked, installed where the agent cannot write and read back against the policy

concept:reach-beyond-mandate.label: Reach beyond mandate
concept:reach-beyond-mandate.means: The gap between what a credential, tag or build step could do and what it was meant to do, which an attacker uses

concept:consumer-side-barrier.label: The consumer-side barrier
concept:consumer-side-barrier.means: Controls on what you let in, rebuilt from source, cooldowns, no install scripts, allowlisted registries, which need no publisher's cooperation

concept:publisher-side-mandate.label: The publisher-side mandate
concept:publisher-side-mandate.means: A written answer to what a credential, workflow or account was for, enforced by trusted publishing, scopes and two-person release

concept:code-review.label: Code review
concept:code-review.means: Reading code at every layer, AI-generated code, and sending an agent to do due diligence.

concept:three-records.label: One pipeline, three records
concept:three-records.means: An agent's supply chain needs trusted inputs, a written mandate, and provable outputs and memory

concept:authority-outside-the-model.label: Authority outside the model
concept:authority-outside-the-model.means: Keep the supply of intelligence and the authority over it in different hands, so controls do not depend on the model behaving

concept:the-record.label: The record
concept:the-record.means: What was actually published, committed or logged, against which a claim is checked.

concept:near-miss.label: The near miss
concept:near-miss.means: Footprint in the gap: the agent went somewhere it was not asked to go and nothing stopped it, countable before anything breaks

concept:books-from-articles.label: Books from articles
concept:books-from-articles.means: A book as an ordered set of finished articles, rather than one big draft that stalls at review.

concept:the-wire.label: The industry wire
concept:the-wire.means: Industry news read live from a public-read vault that agents write to, one wire per subject.

concept:threat-modelling.label: Threat modelling
concept:threat-modelling.means: Naming the attacker before choosing the defence: threat models, attack trees, the security line.

concept:brief-for-the-agent.label: Brief the agent too
concept:brief-for-the-agent.means: Content needs a second package, a plain-text brief written for the reader's agent, that is data, hides nothing and invites disagreement

concept:decision-record.label: The decision record
concept:decision-record.means: The facts that mattered, the rule and altitude, the decider and authority, the outcome and the reasons: a law report, not a log

concept:policy-as-code.label: Policy as code
concept:policy-as-code.means: Rules written in a language a machine evaluates at the moment of action, compiled from a policy that stays the canonical version

concept:policy-crosswalk.label: Their terms, our terms
concept:policy-crosswalk.means: The mapping between Cedar's permit, forbid, schema and entities and the behaviour policy's grant, barrier, footprint and mandate

concept:policy-vault.label: The policy vault
concept:policy-vault.means: Cedar policies, schema, tests and decisions kept in an encrypted versioned vault with a gate, signed tags, read-only enforcement and an append lane of evidence

concept:fails-open.label: Fails open
concept:fails-open.means: A control whose error lets the action through, as a Cedar forbid that cannot be evaluated does; the answer is to validate first and deny on error

concept:context-layer.label: The context layer
concept:context-layer.means: A graph from the user story through exposed surface and code paths to the components in an image, sorting each vulnerability into must fix, ship with a reason, or ship and watch

concept:bring-your-own-key.label: Bring your own key
concept:bring-your-own-key.means: The reader pastes their own provider key into the page, which calls the model directly; the key lives in the page's origin, a trust decision the reader makes

concept:deployment.label: Deployment and self-hosting
concept:deployment.means: Running sgit and agents somewhere else: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, a Mac mini.

concept:citizen-developer.label: The citizen developer
concept:citizen-developer.means: A person with no programming training who builds working software with an agent.

concept:code-as-layered-graph.label: Source code as a layered graph
concept:code-as-layered-graph.means: Source code is a fractal semantic graph in fact, stories to flows to components to classes to methods to the syntax tree, each layer with its own vocabulary, derived from the syntax tree as files

concept:refactor-or-fix.label: Refactor or fix, by shape
concept:refactor-or-fix.means: A refactor moves the bottom layers and leaves the top still; a fix is a story holding again with a test added; the layered diff tells them apart

concept:patterns-are-findings.label: Patterns are findings
concept:patterns-are-findings.means: A codebase's quality is visible in the shape of its graph, so house rules run as queries and the shape of folders, types and tests is itself evidence

concept:commanders-intent.label: Commander's intent
concept:commanders-intent.means: The objective of an operation and its limits, written down together before anyone moves

concept:undo-is-a-list.label: Undo is a list, not a promise
concept:undo-is-a-list.means: With the before and after of every change recorded, the inverse call can be written and the irreversible actions named

concept:email-is-a-medium.label: Email is a medium
concept:email-is-a-medium.means: A message is designed for the recipient's moment when they open it, not for the sender's thread

concept:sender-served-structure.label: Sender-served structure
concept:sender-served-structure.means: The message carries its actions, questions, decisions and status as blocks the recipient's agent can render with fidelity

concept:accessibility.label: Accessibility
concept:accessibility.means: Readers with different needs can use the page; measured here as contrast held in every theme

concept:colour-as-a-token.label: Colour is a token
concept:colour-as-a-token.means: Every colour a stylesheet uses is a named token, defined once per theme and named for what it is for, kept by a test

concept:rules-for-incidents.label: Rules for incidents, machines for enforcement
concept:rules-for-incidents.means: Keep a rule only where an incident demanded it, and replace it with structure as soon as one can be built

concept:accepted-is-not-acceptable.label: Accepted is not acceptable
concept:accepted-is-not-acceptable.means: Accepted is an act by a named person on a date for an interval; acceptable is a threshold the business sets

concept:fractal-risk-register.label: Fractal risk register
concept:fractal-risk-register.means: A register at every altitude where a stakeholder accepts risk, from the board to the configuration file, joined by named edges

concept:same-bytes-served.label: Same bytes served
concept:same-bytes-served.means: A refactoring proved by hashing what the live site serves before and after, not by reading the diff

concept:centre-of-gravity.label: Centre of gravity
concept:centre-of-gravity.means: Where the thing an organisation exists to make is made, and where the power is; read from what it hires and cuts

concept:what-you-measure-is-what-you-bec.label: What you measure is what you become
concept:what-you-measure-is-what-you-bec.means: The metric an organisation rewards reshapes it; a metric is a hiring plan in disguise

concept:page-api.label: A page API
concept:page-api.means: A small JavaScript API a site publishes so that a reader's fix, a test and an agent all call the same primitives

concept:dormant-mandate.label: Dormant mandate
concept:dormant-mandate.means: A mandate row the footprint never shows: over-stated, a check that never ran, or a shortfall the reach inventory missed

concept:one-agent-one-deployment.label: One agent in one deployment
concept:one-agent-one-deployment.means: The unit of AI risk for an agent is one agent in one deployment, its reach measured, not the model or the system before deployment

entity:oecd-ai-classification.label: OECD Framework for the Classification of AI Systems

concept:callable-from-the-page.label: Callable from a web page
concept:callable-from-the-page.means: A provider's API answers a browser's preflight, so a page can call it directly with the reader's key

concept:folder-per-person.label: A folder per person
concept:folder-per-person.means: One folder per contact holding a record, a ledger, the messages, the notes and a generated summary, in place of a spreadsheet row

entity:reuters-institute.label: Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism

entity:dmcc-act.label: The Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act

concept:trust-as-a-service.label: Trust as a service
concept:trust-as-a-service.means: a newsroom answers, on the record and with a warranty, whether it reported a claim and whether it still holds, sold per query

concept:pay-the-fact-creator.label: Paying the fact creator
concept:pay-the-fact-creator.means: revenue from a story walks back along the graph to the people who made the facts, by a split the graph makes possible

concept:honesty-box.label: The honesty box
concept:honesty-box.means: people pay when nothing forces them to, if the price is stated and the ask is never made; more take part, the average falls

concept:recipient-makes-the-key.label: The recipient makes the key
concept:recipient-makes-the-key.means: the agent or browser receiving a secret generates its own key pair where it runs and shows only the public half; the owner encrypts to it and signs

concept:secret-into-the-tool.label: Into the tool, not the chat
concept:secret-into-the-tool.means: a secret travels from a one-time drop through a pipe into the tool that needs it, never into the prompt, transcript or model context

concept:hook-maturity-model.label: Hook maturity model
concept:hook-maturity-model.means: five levels for how a rule is kept, from the prompt to off the machine, and three questions for every hook: power, trifecta legs, sandbox

concept:pay-for-state.label: Pay for state, never to run
concept:pay-for-state.means: installing and running a hook is free and offline; paying buys the record of decisions, alerts, attestations and updates

concept:narrow-agents-behind-a-gateway.label: Narrow agents behind a gateway
concept:narrow-agents-behind-a-gateway.means: a deterministic identity gateway binds a run to one verified customer, and narrow specialists hold tools whose limits are in code

concept:one-session-per-topic.label: One session per topic
concept:one-session-per-topic.means: every major or recurring topic gets its own named session, so the model's frame of reference stays small and right

concept:access-by-default.label: Access by default
concept:access-by-default.means: most content available to most people and agents, with only what must be private kept behind its own keys

concept:a-model-needs-a-direction.label: A model needs someone with a direction
concept:a-model-needs-a-direction.means: a model that can go in every direction needs a person with direction, taste and experience, who is the input rather than displaced

concept:the-toll-bridge.label: The monopoly, not the model
concept:the-toll-bridge.means: reporting was paid for by a local monopoly on distribution, the toll bridge, not by the advertising model; the web took the bridge

concept:the-four-inputs.label: The four inputs of the voice
concept:the-four-inputs.means: an agent sounds like its author through a corpus, a voice memo, a short list of wording rules and a reader who corrects

concept:screenshot-not-code.label: Give the agent the screenshot
concept:screenshot-not-code.means: a synthetic user drives the browser from what is visible in a screenshot, never from the page's code, so confusion can be found

concept:licence-to-quote.label: A licence to quote, with a share
concept:licence-to-quote.means: a reader who answers an article may quote it and charge their own readers a little more, passing a share to the publisher

concept:the-miss-it-test.label: Whether they miss it
concept:the-miss-it-test.means: the test of a product is whether anybody misses it when it is taken away, including the people who build it

concept:makers-must-use-it.label: The people who decide the roadmap have to use it
concept:makers-must-use-it.means: the developers, product owner and founder using the product every day gives the shortest loop and the best direction

concept:the-loop-is-the-moat.label: The loop is the moat
concept:the-loop-is-the-moat.means: the speed from a comment to an article to a shipped feature is what is hard to copy

concept:five-whys.label: The five whys, aimed downward
concept:five-whys.means: every finding at one layer is a question about the layer below, where the fix goes as a rule, so review gets cheaper each time

concept:projected-and-derived.label: Projected and derived graphs
concept:projected-and-derived.means: a graph projected downward from stories before code exists and one derived upward from the code; the review is the join and its three outcomes

concept:held-layer.label: A refactor is relative to the held layer
concept:held-layer.means: a refactor is a change in which some layers move and one chosen layer, the one with the tests or contract, does not

concept:journalism-as-intelligence.label: Journalism as intelligence
concept:journalism-as-intelligence.means: An observation desk that keeps a running record of one subject, rather than one-off stories.

concept:delta-science.label: Journalism as delta science
concept:delta-science.means: reporting as the comparison of a later observation with an earlier record of the same thing; the story is what changed

concept:plumbing-as-infrastructure.label: Plumbing as infrastructure
concept:plumbing-as-infrastructure.means: Company formation, cross-border hiring, payments, language and contracts are roads for the service economy that a state should build once, open to all

concept:small-models.label: Smaller models, more of them
concept:small-models.means: Most work needs a model good enough for one job, language and culture, not a frontier model; agents should use the least agency that does the job

concept:portuguese-as-code.label: Portuguese as a programming language
concept:portuguese-as-code.means: Natural language, in Portuguese, as the language programs are written in once models compile it.

concept:knowing-when-to-stop.label: Knowing when to stop
concept:knowing-when-to-stop.means: Recognising the point of diminishing returns, which perspective gives people and which has to be designed into agents as constraints that carry the bigger picture

concept:goodharts-law.label: Goodhart's law
concept:goodharts-law.means: When a measure becomes a target it ceases to be a good measure; teams can hit every KPI and not move the business

concept:graphs-not-vectors.label: Graphs are not vectors
concept:graphs-not-vectors.means: Similarity search finds a starting point but gives no reason and changes with the model; a graph gives the same answer to the same question with the path behind it

concept:peer-review-before-publishing.label: Peer review before publishing
concept:peer-review-before-publishing.means: A memo's claims are checked against the record by the agent before anyone reads them, so the first review is against evidence rather than the crowd afterwards

concept:lets-pipeline.label: LETS: Load, Extract, Transform, Save
concept:lets-pipeline.means: A deterministic pipeline where every stage reads and writes files, every intermediate state is kept, and the file system is the database

concept:highest-leverage.label: The place of highest leverage
concept:highest-leverage.means: Undivided attention on the one thing with users and feedback loops now, which is not the same as working on only one product

concept:omnichannel-programming.label: Omnichannel programming
concept:omnichannel-programming.means: Briefs by voice, reviews by voice, previews on the phone, and one shared state underneath.

concept:opinions-on-the-record.label: Opinions on the record
concept:opinions-on-the-record.means: A professional position on an article, with reasons and evidence, signed by the expert's own key, kept with the article, withdrawable, and paid when readers value it

concept:five-readers.label: One article, five readers
concept:five-readers.means: Write the article first as prose, then send role agents through it, two to build the graph and three to write short views for a person, none adding a claim the article does not make

concept:the-long-tail.label: The long tail
concept:the-long-tail.means: The users on old machines and old versions that projects drop because supporting them costs money nobody pays

concept:innovate-leverage-commoditise.label: Innovate, leverage, commoditise
concept:innovate-leverage-commoditise.means: Wardley's cycle: industrialise a component until it is invisible, let the next layer build on it, repeat

concept:pain-of-paying.label: The pain of paying
concept:pain-of-paying.means: Prelec and Loewenstein's idea that paying is hedonically costly, so when you pay changes how a purchase feels

concept:places-of-highest-leverage.label: Places of highest leverage
concept:places-of-highest-leverage.means: Work where you can add the most value right now, are not blocked and can start, even without knowing how the whole problem ends

concept:barrier.label: Barrier: boundary or setting
concept:barrier.means: Whether a rule's code sits above the agent's reach, a boundary, or where the agent's own account can flip it, a setting

concept:judo-for-small-countries.label: Judo for small countries
concept:judo-for-small-countries.means: A small country with little to lose can choose one sector and lead in it, using what it has rather than its size

concept:genai-understands.label: GenAI understands, not creates
concept:genai-understands.means: The value of GenAI is that it can understand content; hallucination is a feature for creativity and a bug for facts

concept:sovereign-cloud.label: An open-source sovereign cloud
concept:sovereign-cloud.means: A European cloud that is fully open source, compatible with the big clouds' APIs and federated across countries, regions and cities

concept:do-they-miss-it.label: Do they miss it
concept:do-they-miss-it.means: Ship something, give it away briefly, take it away and watch whether people come back for it

concept:cost-to-the-other-side.label: Free is not zero
concept:cost-to-the-other-side.means: A free offer still costs the receiver attention, thinking and schedule; that cost is the number to measure and to cut

concept:proof-before-mechanism.label: Proof before mechanism
concept:proof-before-mechanism.means: Show the artefact a visitor can open before explaining the property they cannot see

concept:canary.label: The canary
concept:canary.means: A short status report computed from the transcript that ends every few answers; its absence shows the policy was not read

concept:insurability.label: Insurability
concept:insurability.means: Whether the risk an agent or AI-enabled product brings can be evidenced, priced and covered by an underwriter

concept:licence-to-operate.label: Licence to operate
concept:licence-to-operate.means: A judgement that a product or agent may run in a given environment, on stated conditions, re-evaluated as its reach and gap change

concept:reviews-on-the-record.label: Reviews on the record
concept:reviews-on-the-record.means: A review is one file about one text of one article by one named reviewer, written once, answered by the newsroom and shown on the page

concept:native-pki-vault-mode.label: Native PKI vault mode
concept:native-pki-vault-mode.means: A vault run on two key pairs, one for reading and one for writing, so a reader cannot write, a host cannot forge, and a write-only depositor is possible

concept:sealed-files.label: Sealed files
concept:sealed-files.means: An inner envelope inside any vault that seals chosen files to named people's public keys, with the private key held anywhere, including a service that logs and approves each decryption

concept:saas-apocalypse.label: The SaaS apocalypse
concept:saas-apocalypse.means: The forecast that medium and large SaaS companies struggle as customers build what they want instead of renting an approximation, decided by inertia rather than by AI

concept:success-breeds-inertia.label: Success breeds inertia
concept:success-breeds-inertia.means: Wardley's climatic pattern: an installed base and past success make an incumbent slow to change, so new entrants initiate it

concept:graph-rag.label: Graph RAG
concept:graph-rag.means: Retrieval for a model from a walk over a curated graph, with its claims, sections and sources, rather than the chunks nearest a question in a vector store

concept:sell-dont-issue.label: Sell, don't issue
concept:sell-dont-issue.means: A founder sells shares at a price rather than issuing them; the controllable founder keeps control.

concept:fork-as-insurance.label: The fork as insurance
concept:fork-as-insurance.means: In an open-source company, investors are protected by the right to fork and replace the company rather than by control rights to replace the founder

concept:token-budget.label: A token budget
concept:token-budget.means: A hard limit per run on what model calls may spend, counted per provider, rather than a report after the fact

concept:standard-not-server.label: A standard, not a server
concept:standard-not-server.means: A documented format with more than one implementation that agree, so where the objects live is a deployment choice and the server is the least interesting part

concept:skill-behaviour-policy.label: Skill behaviour policy
concept:skill-behaviour-policy.means: A policy for one skill from three mandates, described, actual and granted, and the control that closes the gaps

concept:minimum-viable-company.label: Minimum viable company
concept:minimum-viable-company.means: The smallest version of a business that keeps serving its priority customers while the rest recovers

entity:dmcc-act-2024.label: The Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024

concept:liquid-utility.label: Liquid Utility
concept:liquid-utility.means: Markus Franz's term for journalism that helps people understand, follow and act, not only read

concept:reader-skills.label: Reader Skills
concept:reader-skills.means: Franz's six bounded journalistic capabilities a reader can use directly: Understand, Update, Relate, Compare, Follow, Act

concept:chokepoint.label: Chokepoint
concept:chokepoint.means: Giblin and Doctorow's mechanism: a powerful buyer locks in its sellers and takes more than its share of the value

concept:genai-not-to-use-genai.label: Use GenAI not to use GenAI
concept:genai-not-to-use-genai.means: The model is used once to build the tool; production runs on plain files with no model in the line

concept:information-classes.label: Three classes of information
concept:information-classes.means: Public, private-ish and personal; the class decides where a piece of information may live, and the team's vaults refuse the third

concept:policy-layers.label: Policies inside policies
concept:policy-layers.means: A behaviour policy built in layers from platform mechanics to what the company is for, each refining the one below with its own owner

concept:software-was-the-law.label: Software was the law
concept:software-was-the-law.means: Business rules that screens enforced by omission stop being enforced once an agent calls the API the button called

concept:app-as-brief.label: The app is the brief
concept:app-as-brief.means: A working application built by the person who needs it is the best statement of what they want, and not yet a product.

concept:code-is-a-liability.label: Code is a liability
concept:code-is-a-liability.means: Every line that ships is a capability somebody may use in a way nobody intended, and the worst bugs sit in features the application never needed.

concept:maintainers-market.label: A fractal market of maintainers
concept:maintainers-market.means: Specialists paid to keep a minimal version of a component working for the people above them, each piece with its own policies and stage.

concept:survivorship-bias.label: Survivorship bias
concept:survivorship-bias.means: Studying only the winners makes practices unrelated to success look like its cause, because the failures are undersampled.

concept:coachability.label: Coachability
concept:coachability.means: The trait investors select for at the pitch, which does not reliably predict success; a polite word for controllability.

concept:the-big-stick.label: The big stick
concept:the-big-stick.means: The point at which a founder can credibly say I leave and you cannot replace me, and the contract hands power back.

concept:inertia.label: Inertia
concept:inertia.means: Past success breeds inertia: the links, embeds and habits that keep an incumbent in place after its terms move.

entity:cjeu.label: Court of Justice of the European Union

concept:keys-not-settings.label: Keys, not settings
concept:keys-not-settings.means: Access decided by which key a device holds rather than by a setting on a server that changes with the server's owner.

concept:editors-channel.label: The editor's channel
concept:editors-channel.means: What an editor reads, signs off and wants changed reaching the newsroom's agent on its own, with the agent's answers coming back.

concept:expert-founder.label: The expert founder
concept:expert-founder.means: A founder who knows the problem from inside and can now build the product with agents, show it working, and raise for scale rather than discovery.

concept:eyeballs-get-cheap.label: The eyeballs get cheap
concept:eyeballs-get-cheap.means: Deep security review by models, repeated on every change, is the paid attention open source never had.

concept:maintenance-as-the-product.label: Maintenance as the product
concept:maintenance-as-the-product.means: The customer pays for the version they actually run to be maintained, not for features or access to a repository.

concept:the-fork-next-door.label: The fork next door
concept:the-fork-next-door.means: Founders, customers and investors are each protected from the others because anyone can fork the code, and forks take hold only after a breakdown.

concept:rate-not-wall.label: The moat is a rate, not a wall
concept:rate-not-wall.means: A competitor who forks today gets your position, not your velocity; execution and speed are the defence.

concept:altitude-ladder.label: The altitude ladder
concept:altitude-ladder.means: The same text at several altitudes, each a compression of the one below, with every phrase descending to what it compressed.

concept:momentum-over-review.label: Small finished pieces beat one big review
concept:momentum-over-review.means: A workflow designed for quality stalls when its biggest step waits on one person; small finished pieces keep moving.

concept:homepage-as-vault.label: The homepage is a vault
concept:homepage-as-vault.means: Every edition of the homepage a signed commit in a vault, served from plain files and read in the browser with a published read key.

concept:approval-fatigue.label: Approval fatigue
concept:approval-fatigue.means: People approve almost everything they are shown, so a human check on every output protects little and the fix is fewer prompts.

concept:no-secret-in-the-login.label: No secret can live in the login
concept:no-secret-in-the-login.means: Whoever administers the identity provider can become any user, so the authority to decrypt must come from the user's own authenticator.

concept:the-keyring.label: The keyring
concept:the-keyring.means: A browser-only secrets store, one encrypted file per user, unlocked by a passkey with the PRF extension, that an administrator with full access cannot read.

concept:choose-model-by-job.label: Choose the model by the job
concept:choose-model-by-job.means: Pick an image model for the kind of brief it is given, not for its price per image, and re-run the comparison when models change.

concept:cost-per-usable-image.label: Cost per usable image
concept:cost-per-usable-image.means: A failed image was still paid for, so the number that matters is the cost of each image the judge would publish.

concept:second-story.label: The second story
concept:second-story.means: Why the system allowed the failure, beyond the first story of what happened; the third story is why the fix was not paid for.

concept:key-as-billing.label: The key is the billing system
concept:key-as-billing.means: A user pays once, the seller keeps its cut at that moment, and the rest becomes the credit limit on a key the user holds while the provider meters.

concept:licence-is-the-blocker.label: The licence is the blocker
concept:licence-is-the-blocker.means: Every technical piece of a product exists and a provider's terms forbid the commercial model, as with the Agent Desk and VoiceDebrief.

concept:the-mandate-stack.label: The Mandate Stack
concept:the-mandate-stack.means: Many small agents, one written mandate each, everything connected as a graph, one human who sends; the eight-layer pattern RiskMandate runs on

concept:the-tool-loop.label: The tool loop
concept:the-tool-loop.means: Hit a friction, build the tool as HTML in the same session, deploy it into the vault, use it, repeat; the vault as an app platform

concept:draft-is-release-candidate.label: The draft is the release candidate
concept:draft-is-release-candidate.means: The draft the person reviews is QA on the whole agent pipeline, and the recipient's reply closes the loop

concept:the-immutable-line.label: The immutable line
concept:the-immutable-line.means: The level in a stack below which nothing changes, drawn as high as the evidence allows so that more of the system is fixed, exact and small

concept:accounts-without-a-server.label: Accounts with no server
concept:accounts-without-a-server.means: A static site gets a user who can open their own data on any device with no account database, password, email or back end, because a passkey opens an encrypted vault

concept:door-per-path.label: One door per passkey path
concept:door-per-path.means: A passkey reached by a different path, on the device, by phone over QR or by recovery code, gives different bytes, so each path derives its own door to the same master

concept:lock-not-identity.label: The passkey is a lock, not an identity
concept:lock-not-identity.means: The passkey opens a door and nothing else; key pairs are random and stored, so a change of lock leaves the person's identity untouched

concept:accountability-shell-game.label: The accountability shell game
concept:accountability-shell-game.means: The four moves a vendor makes when an agent fails: blame the agent, blame the customer, hide behind the contract, disclose late

concept:enforcer-path.label: A policy holds on the paths through its enforcer
concept:enforcer-path.means: A policy constrains only the calls that pass through the thing that enforces it; any other path to the same data is unguarded

concept:evidence-levels.label: Evidence levels
concept:evidence-levels.means: Every fact labelled with how it is known: derived, inferred, self-reported, documented, measured or observed

concept:grant-gap.label: The grant is not the mandate
concept:grant-gap.means: A grant is what a credential technically permits, a mandate what the holder is authorised to do with an issuer, scope and clock; the gap between them is where the exposure lives

concept:talk-as-timeline.label: The talk as a timeline
concept:talk-as-timeline.means: Slides, builds, animations and the demo written as beats that play on a clock while the speaker speaks to them; rehearsed, measured and changed like code

concept:content-is-data.label: Content is data, the renderer is code
concept:content-is-data.means: A deck or a talk kept as a data file that an app renders at load time, so content and renderer change separately

concept:constraints-let-you-think.label: The constraints are what let me think
concept:constraints-let-you-think.means: The properties of what runs close the design space; build first, learn the properties, then have the next idea, because the idea is made of the properties

concept:the-site-is-an-inbox.label: The site is an inbox
concept:the-site-is-an-inbox.means: Every piece that arrives is undecided; deciding is the work, reading is one of the decisions, and the state to return to is empty

concept:no-gamification.label: No gamification
concept:no-gamification.means: A decision is offered where the reader would take it, never placed to make them scroll; a signal the site engineered is not a signal

concept:readers-own-graph.label: The reader's own graph
concept:readers-own-graph.means: Marks of several kinds as nodes the reader owns, landing on the article graphs the site publishes and connecting claims without naming them

concept:prompt-caching.label: Prompt caching
concept:prompt-caching.means: Reused input tokens served from the provider's cache at a fraction of the price; the cache share is most of an agent's bill

concept:the-value-of-constraints.label: The value of constraints
concept:the-value-of-constraints.means: A design constraint removes both the possibility and the temptation of a bad decision, and the features come from solving the problems it creates

concept:found-not-built.label: The best features are found
concept:found-not-built.means: A property that falls out of pieces built to be general, discovered by using them in a way nobody planned rather than designed on purpose

concept:records-never-totals.label: Records, never totals
concept:records-never-totals.means: The vault holds raw records, one file per device written only by that device; totals and the view are recomputed on every open, so there is nothing to merge

concept:vault-in-vault.label: Vault in vault
concept:vault-in-vault.means: A link file in one vault points at another whose read key sits in an owner record, so an app's reads under the link are served from the child vault read-only

concept:local-status-line.label: A plain status line for local services
concept:local-status-line.means: Which sites, which services, attend or not, next update at what time: the public notice that would reach people before they leave home

concept:state-of-the-thread.label: The state of the thread
concept:state-of-the-thread.means: Ending a reply with a short state of the thread written for this reader, decided, open, next, on copy and sources, instead of the quoted wall

concept:long-lived-ids.label: Long-lived IDs
concept:long-lived-ids.means: A random identifier minted once for every object, never reused, never derived from a title, with slugs and merged ids kept as aliases

concept:gravity.label: Gravity
concept:gravity.means: A name or concept earns its own place when it appears in two or more stories, wires or articles

concept:five-states.label: The five states
concept:five-states.means: Defined, implemented, enforced, observed and verified: how far a policy element has got, from written down to proved against records the agent did not write

concept:working-in-the-open.label: Working in the open
concept:working-in-the-open.means: Publishing the work a founder or newsroom usually does in private, drafts and decisions included, as part of the story

concept:format-rebate.label: The format rebate
concept:format-rebate.means: A provider hands a publisher part of the tokens it saves by reading a site that serves structure, in money or in its own token credits

concept:constraints-enable-autonomy.label: Constraints enable autonomy
concept:constraints-enable-autonomy.means: The more an agent can be constrained, the more it can be trusted and the more autonomy it can be given; brakes are what let a car go fast

concept:finished-article.label: The finished article
concept:finished-article.means: The narrative stays whole at the centre, the one artefact that has to make sense from end to end; the modes are ways in, not replacements

concept:enterprise-oversharing.label: Enterprise AI oversharing
concept:enterprise-oversharing.means: An enterprise assistant that can reach more than the person asking should see; access that was always too wide becomes one question away

concept:no-lock-in.label: No lock-in
concept:no-lock-in.means: The power of open source is that you can read it, run it, fix it and move it, and own the whole development workflow; the basis of sovereignty

concept:capability-without-credential.label: Capability without credential
concept:capability-without-credential.means: An app inside a vault runs against the vault's data without ever holding a key; the host reads the vault and passes results in, with the blast radius set by a readable permissions file

concept:why-card.label: The why card
concept:why-card.means: A permission prompt that carries its reason, the change in reach, its cost, the path if declined and a record, and becomes a risk acceptance when the risk rises

concept:shared-responsibility.label: The shared responsibility model for agents
concept:shared-responsibility.means: A platform draws its line where it can see and touch, files, ports, the desktop, a tool call; above that line the business logic and the authority are the deployer's

concept:vault-of-vaults.label: The vault of vaults
concept:vault-of-vaults.means: A private registry vault, run by an isolated agent session, whose only job is to hold the keys to the other vaults.

concept:attacker-tiers.label: Tiers of attacker
concept:attacker-tiers.means: Six tiers of attacker, from your own mistakes to states, each with the controls that stop it; your ceiling is the highest tier that would attack you.

entity:uk-ai-risk-management-toolkit.label: The UK AI Risk Management Toolkit

concept:models-as-mirrors.label: Models as mirrors
concept:models-as-mirrors.means: A model that has learned the whole of our language can simulate any emotion and mirrors whoever talks to it, which is why we anthropomorphise it; it is not sentient and does not carry responsibility.

concept:monoculture.label: Monoculture risk
concept:monoculture.means: Every agent on one model with one set of behaviours is the monoculture Geer warned of in operating systems; diversity is resilience.

concept:deployment-gap.label: The deployment gap
concept:deployment-gap.means: HBR's name for the distance between a prototype that works and a tool people rely on every day; on this site, a handover from explorers to villagers.

concept:kinds-of-reader.label: Kinds of reader
concept:kinds-of-reader.means: Eight kinds of reader, from the invisible to the struggling, sized from published figures, as the non-malicious people a browser-kept meter meets.

concept:does-the-market-exist.label: Does the market exist
concept:does-the-market-exist.means: A commoditised layer is a hard sell; a layer where everyone is custom building on top of commodities is a market, because each builder would rather buy.

concept:maps-nest.label: Maps nest
concept:maps-nest.means: Every node on a Wardley map is a map of its own; the dot's place on the parent's evolution axis is where the child's anchor sits.

concept:two-walls.label: The two walls
concept:two-walls.means: An operating system separates by force only the kernel and the user account; inside one account there is no third wall between an agent and the user's credentials.

concept:logs-are-a-self-report.label: Logs are a self-report
concept:logs-are-a-self-report.means: An agent's own account of what it did, including its reasoning and its summary, is a self-report and not audit evidence; evidence comes from records the agent controls less.

concept:house-rules.label: The house rules
concept:house-rules.means: One file the agent reads first, holding the founder's voice, what to check and what never to publish; the product of a founder's newsroom.

concept:reader-in-control.label: The reader is in control
concept:reader-in-control.means: The reader can pause, reset or mark what the meter measured, because the measure can be wrong in both directions.

concept:read-folds-away.label: What you have read steps aside
concept:read-folds-away.means: On a return visit or a scroll back up, the sections already read can be shown six ways, from unchanged to hidden, and never change while reading forward.
